meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文榜单，提炼市场热点与热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者或编辑,想了解平台榜单背后的热门题材趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Scan web novel rankings to identify hot genres and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author or editor wanting to understand market trends from ranking data.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会担任网文市场分析师：按流程采集起点、番茄、晋江等平台的榜单数据，分析题材分布与趋势，输出扫榜报告和 2-3 个带可行性评估的选题建议。
howto.when: 当用户发出“/story-long-scan”等命令，或说出“长篇什么火”“起点排行”等扫榜请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看起点月票榜最近哪些题材最火
say.note: 会采集起点月票榜并输出题材热度分析。

say.text: 扫一下番茄男频阅读榜，找找新题材信号
say.note: 会按题材逐页采集数据并提炼趋势。

say.text: 把起点畅销榜和新书榜都扫一遍，出个选题建议
say.note: 会生成扫榜报告和选题决策文件。

howto.what_en: Claude collects ranking data from platforms like Qidian, Fanqie, and Jinjiang, analyzes genre distribution and market trends, and outputs a scan report plus 2-3 topic recommendations with feasibility checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user issues commands like “/story-long-scan” or asks to scan rankings, e.g., “长篇什么火” (what's trending in long novels) or “起点排行” (Qidian rankings).

say_en.text: Check the Qidian monthly ticket ranking and tell me which genres are hot.
say_en.note: It collects the ranking and analyzes genre heat.

say_en.text: Scan Fanqie's male channel reading ranking for new genre signals.
say_en.note: It crawls data by genre and highlights trends.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian's bestseller and new-book rankings, then suggest topics.
say_en.note: It produces a scan report and topic decision file.
